_template: Vertical short, 3 scenes, about 30s, 1080x1920 for Reels, Shorts and TikTok. Subtitles group 4 words, stat card sits top centre. Keep everything meaningful above the bottom 260px where platform UI sits.

style.artPrompt: flat vector cartoon illustration, bold clean black outlines, high contrast saturated colours, strong central subject framed for a tall vertical crop, expressive faces, warm Indian skin tones, simple graphic shapes, no text, no lettering, no numbers, no watermark

scenes.narration: HOOK in the first three seconds. State the claim flat, no throat clearing. Twenty four to thirty words, spoken, not written.

images.prompt: The single strongest image of the whole story, one subject dead centre, plenty of headroom for the title card, dramatic light.

scenes.narration: THE EVIDENCE. One piece of proof, one number, spelled as words. Do not add a second idea here, there is no room in thirty seconds.

images.prompt: A tall composition that shows the mechanism or the consequence, subject in the upper two thirds of the frame.

scenes.narration: THE TURN. What the viewer should now think or do, then a reason to follow. Land it in under thirty words.

images.prompt: A resolution image, brighter palette than the previous frames, subject centred, clean background for the outro card.
